result.summary: The page appears mostly functional and well-structured. One notable visual issue was identified related to text truncation in a restaurant name.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is truncated mid-word without an ellipsis, making it appear broken rather than intentionally clipped.
issues.suggestion: Apply CSS text-overflow: ellipsis with overflow: hidden and white-space: nowrap to restaurant name labels so truncation is visually indicated with '...' rather than an abrupt mid-word cut.
